nom: JIYU Cleansing Polish Pads - Korean Skincare for Clogged Pores

segments.oily: One reviewer reports the pads work really well on her oily skin, while cautioning that sensitive skin should not rub too hard with them.

concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the pads work really well for her, while cautioning that sensitive skin should avoid rubbing too hard.

aspects.libelle: Double-sided pad: textured exfoliating side, smoother cleansing side
Effectively lifts leftover dirt, makeup and residue
Requires a light touch; hard scrubbing discouraged, especially for sensitive skin

extraits.texte: Love - love - looove these pads! 😍 These are definitely thicker than their “sister” (the JIYU toning pads), and work well for acne/blemish prone skin. Be mindful of the scrubbing side… a light scrub in a circular motion is all you’ll need. I will be keeping these in rotation with the JIYU Toning/Brightening pads for sure! 😊

Love love love!! The double sided pad is super effective for removing dirt and make up. I double cleanse then use before skincare. Still amazed at what the pad picks up and feel like all of my serums have a better chance at working with a truly clean canvas!
The other pads along with this exfoliating one has made a big difference in my face. It has helped me with brightening my face and providing a nourished look.

extraits.titre: Don't forget to wash it off.
extraits.texte: If you have sensitive skin, don't rub hard with the pad. They work really well on my oily skin.
Love it !!!!Great Product .it is amoithing and corrects Texture ~ Dont miss out on this Wonderful buy 💫💫💫💫💫

I love the way my skin looks and feels after using these. I have not seen any results yet but have only used for a couple weeks. I look forward to the next few weeks and hopefully will see visible improvement.

reserve: Only a handful of reviews are available and most are short and general, so there is limited detail on skin types and concerns beyond oily skin and general brightening or texture effects.
